acceptance_criteria: Typing the right name after a refusal puts the hold hint back at once; a name made wrong during a running hold shows the German refusal

Inner whitespace is compared collapsed (two spaces or a no-break space count as one space) and emoji variation selector U+FE0F is ignored on both sides; any other difference still refuses, with a hint when only spacing or such marks differ
The name label wraps long names (overflow-wrap: anywhere); the field's aria-describedby names the title and the loss text
The refusal is tested with Enter and Space as well as with a pointer
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: Make the typed-name delete confirmation clearer without weakening it: the line under the button follows what is typed, a name that looks right but differs in invisible ways is explained, long names wrap, and a screen reader hears what is being deleted.
non_goals: Other delete confirmations (own concepts, gesture examples)
